title: Pack shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the pack file schemas only. Harness-wide shapes (ids, content hash, versions, provenance) live in schemas/common/ and are referenced, not redefined.

generation_timing.description: When the generation path runs (ADR-0014). v0.1 implements 'authoring' only; the Importer refuses the other two until they are implemented. Holdout Templates are always 'authoring'.

relative_path.description: POSIX path relative to the pack root. No leading '/', no '.' or '..' segments, no backslashes, no whitespace.

version_range.description: Comma-separated comparator list, all of which must hold, e.g. '>=0.1.0,<0.2.0' (ADR-0009). Versions compare as SemVer.

document_hash.description: Content hash of a parsed pack document: 'sha256:' + hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the document. Independent of YAML/JSON formatting. A document never contains its own hash.

document_ref.title: Reference to another pack document by path and hash

sandbox_argv.description: argv executed inside the learner sandbox only, never through a shell and never on the host (ADR-0009). argv[0] has no whitespace, so a whole shell command line cannot be smuggled in as one element.

oci_image.title: Container image pinned by digest
oci_image.description: Lab image referenced by digest, never by tag (ADR-0010, ADR-0015).

repository.description: Registry host (optional port) and repository path, without tag or digest, e.g. 'ghcr.io/morphloop/dns-lab'.

media_ref.title: External media reference
media_ref.description: Large asset held outside the pack: URI plus content hash of the bytes (ADR-0015). The store kind is not yet decided, so any absolute URI scheme is accepted.

markdown.description: Learner- or author-facing text; CommonMark. Rendered as text, never executed.

skill_targets.title: Skills an activity or Template trains

difficulty.description: Pack-relative difficulty in [0, 1]; comparison between pack versions is per Template (ADR-0014).

adapter_params.description: Parameters for a domain-adapter item. Opaque to core; the adapter validates them against its own schema at import (ADR-0009). By convention a key named 'argv' is always a sandbox argv.
